title: Sidetrack Adventures
tagline: Sidetrack Adventures explores abandoned ghost towns, forgotten places, and hidde
synopsis: Sidetrack Adventures explores abandoned ghost towns, forgotten places, and hidden history across the wild landscapes of the American West.

episodes.title: Crossing the Mojave Desert on a Road No One Can Explain
episodes.synopsis: A dead-straight road slices 50 miles through the Mojave, eerily aligned toward Palmdale, its purpose unknown, its origin debated, and its silence unsettling.

episodes.title: Exploring Abandoned Highway
episodes.synopsis: Opened in 1933, the Ridge Route Alternate carved a scenic path through Piru Gorge, once a vital highway, now partly submerged beneath Pyramid Lake, its past hidden in the desert.

episodes.title: The Strange Mystery of the Mojave Megaphone
episodes.synopsis: The Mojave Megaphone looms over the desert, a strange steel structure with no known origin. Was it for railroads, or something more mysterious?

episodes.title: Discovering Highway 395 in California's Remote Northeast
episodes.synopsis: Highway 395 winds through California’s remote northeast, where sparse towns and quiet landscapes reveal deep roots in the state’s pioneer past.

episodes.title: Exploring the Ghost Town of Two Guns
episodes.synopsis: Once a lively Route 66 stop, Two Guns, Arizona is now a haunting ghost town, its ruins, abandoned zoo, and the eerie Apache Death Cave echoing its dark past.

episodes.title: Exploring the Appian Way
episodes.synopsis: The Appian Way, Rome’s “Queen of Roads,” began in 312 BC, an ancient highway of empire, lined with ruins and history, still echoing the footsteps of the past.

episodes.title: Abandoned and Forgotten Highway Stops in the Mojave Desert
episodes.synopsis: Once vital desert stops, Halloran Springs and Summit now lie abandoned, faded relics of old highways, forgotten stories, and hidden history along today’s Interstate 15.

episodes.title: Finding the Exact Center of Nevada
episodes.synopsis: Deep in Monitor Valley lies Nevada’s true center, a remote land of hot springs, wild horses, and forgotten roads where history and isolation quietly endure.

episodes.title: The Strange Tale of the Mojave Phone Booth
episodes.synopsis: A lone phone booth in the Mojave became a global obsession, drawing callers to the desert, where abandoned mines and strange landscapes tell its story.

episodes.title: Visiting the Remains of a Top Secret WWII Army Camp
episodes.synopsis: In WWII, Camp Bouse hid a secret mission in the Arizona desert, where soldiers tested a mysterious “Gizmo,” leaving behind traces of one of America’s most hidden camps.

episodes.title: The History & Secrets of the Ortega Highway
episodes.synopsis: Ortega Highway winds from San Juan Capistrano to Lake Elsinore, a scenic yet perilous route through mountains, waterfalls, and historic Southern California landmarks.

episodes.title: Crossing the Mojave Desert on Cadiz Road
episodes.synopsis: Cadiz Road once linked Los Angeles to Phoenix, but now lies nearly forgotten, its vanished towns and desert scars quietly marking a lost Mojave route.
